change: Reuse the default reflection of specialized AIR in nvmtl_translate_samplers for formatless storage-image options. No translation options or cache policy changes.

build.scope: Wrapper shared library only; no LLVM/Mesa/macOS build. Existing locked dependencies; 8 GiB memory limit.

controls: undeclared sampler does not change output
real validator rejects malformed SPIR-V header
trials.method: Actual nvmtl_translate_samplers C ABI; alternating paired batches after warmup, no concurrent builds; copying/freeing/validation excluded from timer; caps=3 as set by NVMTL loader.
trials.limitation: Owned representative texture sampling/position/storage fixtures, not captured WindowServer shaders; Objective-C caches, AIR bitcode reading and NVK compilation not executed.
